critique.evidence: Reduced-motion behavior is correctly proven at all three viewports: the media query matches and the hero remains at opacity 1 with no transform. Runtime timing is solid on tablet/mobile (16.87–17.28 ms average, 0 long frames), but desktop averages 22.36 ms with a 50 ms worst frame. More importantly, the measured mid-frame is effectively identical to the end state on desktop/tablet and exactly identical on mobile, so the evidence does not demonstrate smooth interpolation from opacity 1/transform none to opacity 0.45 with the 3D transform. This is functional but not sufficiently proven or polished for an 8.
critique.fix: Retune or repair the transition so sampled start, midpoint, and endpoint show clear progressive interpolation on every viewport. Target a desktop average near 16.7 ms and eliminate the 50 ms spike, then recapture multiple timestamped frames while preserving the verified reduced-motion override.
